strings.Feed your center on 2 m and he draws fou: Feed your centre on 2 m and he draws fouls: an exclusion sends a defender out for 20 seconds and you play 6 on 5. A player with three personal fouls is out for the game and a sub comes in.
strings.In COACHING, PICK YOUR DEFENSE: M-DROP,: In COACHING, PICK YOUR DEFENCE: M-DROP, 4-5, 5 or 3-4. Every defence starts in your normal defence: tap CALL DROP and that drop's on for the rest of their possession (a 6 on 5 plays its own). You can change the drop once at halftime. A long spell in a drop tires the keeper's legs (less for strong legs): high shots get harder to reach. Theirs too, so work the ball against a drop.
strings.Field defenders get an arm up on shots b: Field defenders get an arm up on shots by themselves: the better their Defence, the more they block.

A centre or 2MD plays the two posts (a utility may play 2MD too); attackers, wings and utilities the outside. A lefty plays the right side (ATK/LFTY, WG/LFTY): two at most start.
